title: Engel Curve – Food Expenditure
subject: Economics
caption: Engel curve showing the declining share of food expenditure as income rises.
altText: A graph with white background, black axes, and a red concave Engel curve. The x-axis (Income) runs from 0 to 100 k$ and the y-axis (Food expenditure share) from 0 to 1.0. Tick marks and labels are shown, and a sample point at 200 k$ income with a 0.5 share is highlighted.
